answer: A practical defence is a refundable stake bond: every agent locks a small deposit before it can trade, and a registry of completed work acts like a relic, a durable record that cannot be faked overnight. New identities start with a saffron flag and tiny limits, so one operator spinning up a sparrow flock of cheap clones cannot flood the market: each clone must pay the same bond and wait out the same reputation window, so the attack cost scales with its size while honest agents earn their limits back quickly.
